name: emby
description: Emby(https://emby.media/) organizes video, music, live TV, and photos from personal media libraries and streams them to smart TVs, streaming boxes and mobile devices. This container is packaged as a standalone emby Media Server.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Emby data storage location. *This can grow very large, 50gb+ is likely for a large collection.*

paths.name: Path: /data/tvshows
paths.description: Media goes here. Add as many as needed e.g. `/data/movies`, `/data/tv`, etc.

paths.name: Path: /data/movies
paths.description: Media goes here. Add as many as needed e.g. `/data/movies`, `/data/tv`, etc.

paths.name: Path: /opt/vc/lib
paths.description: Path for Raspberry Pi OpenMAX libs *optional*.

ports.name: Port: 8920
ports.description: Https webUI (you need to setup your own certificate).

devices.name: /dev/dri
devices.description: Only needed if you want to use your Intel or AMD GPU for hardware accelerated video encoding (vaapi).

devices.name: /dev/video10
devices.description: Only needed if you want to use your Raspberry Pi V4L2 video encoding.

devices.name: /dev/video11
devices.description: Only needed if you want to use your Raspberry Pi V4L2 video encoding.

devices.name: /dev/video12
devices.description: Only needed if you want to use your Raspberry Pi V4L2 video encoding.
